name: MONTH
description: MONTH extracts the month from a date.
tldr: MONTH returns the month (1-12) from a date.

parameters.name: serial_number
parameters.description: The date from which to extract the month.

basicExample.explanation: Returns 7 for July from the date "7/4/2026".

advancedExamples.title: Get month name
advancedExamples.description: Convert month number to month name
advancedExamples.explanation: Uses TEXT function to format the month as a name.

howItWorks: MONTH extracts the month (1-12) from a date serial number.

howToSteps.name: Select output cell
howToSteps.text: Choose where the month should appear.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result shows the month number (1-12).

limitations: MONTH returns 1-12, not the month name.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure the argument is a valid date.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: MONTH works identically in Google Sheets.
